d: IIT Krishna Murthy (Accused) is a 2020 Telugu movie about an IIT Bombay student who travels to Hyderabad to learn about his family and discovers his uncle's mysterious disappearance
Small-time diamond smuggler David befriends Goa-based gangster Abbasi. However, when David begins to build inroads with an international criminal, Abbasi is not happy.
Ajayan, an introverted young man, feels helpless when he is accused of murdering an old woman until Hannah, a novice yet astute lawyer, comes to his rescue.
